    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    BuyDecision
    Represents a decision by a player to buy a card.
    Card
    Represents a card in the game.
    Card.Type
    Represents the type of a card.
    Card.Type.Category
    Represents the category of a card type.
    CardStacks
    Represents the piles of cards available for purchase during the game.
    Decision
    Represents a decision that a player can make during the game.
    EndPhaseDecision
    Represents a decision by a player to end a phase of their turn.
    Engine
    Game execution engine that orchestrates play between players.
    GainCardDecision
    Represents a decision by a player to gain a card.
    GameResult
    Represents the results of a completed game, including all player results sorted in order of decreasing score.
    GameState
    Represents the current, immutable state of the game.
    GameState.TurnPhase
    Represents the phase of a turn.
    Hand
    A Hand represents the collection of cards a player has in their hand during a single turn of the game.
    PlayCardDecision
    Represents a decision by a player to play a card.
    Player
    The interface to a player in a game of Automation: The Game.
    PlayerResult
    Represents a player's result at the end of a game, including their name, score, and ending deck.
    PlayerViolationException
    Exception thrown when a Player violates the game rules or throws an exception.
    TrashCardDecision
    Represents a decision by a player to trash a card.
